meta.title: Union County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Union County's 2026 budget, taken from the county's budget detail report filed with the state. The amounts are the 'Original Budget' column, which is the budget the quorum court adopted for 2026. 3 County General departments print negative transfer lines (-$295,888.90 in all), which lower their totals as printed.

nodes.name: Transfers
nodes.note: The report prints this 'Transfers out' line as a negative number (-$232,821.31), which lowers the department total. The report does not say which fund it is tied to.
